'''''Hosta plantaginea''''', the '''fragrant plantain lily''' or '''August lily''', is a species of flowering plant in the family [[Asparagaceae]], native to southeast and south-central China, and a garden escapee in scattered locations worldwide.<ref name="536625-1" >{{cite web |url=http://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:536625-1 |title=''Hosta plantaginea'' (Lam.) Asch. |author=<!--Not stated--> |website=Plants of the World Online |publisher=Board of Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew |access-date=18 April 2021 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=''Hosta plantaginea'' fragrant plantain lily |url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/8821/Hosta-plantaginea/Details |date=2021 |publisher=The Royal Horticultural Society |access-date=18 April 2021 |quote=Other common names ... August lily, Corfu lily, maruba, tamano-giboshi-kanzashi, yusan }}</ref> This species and cultivars and hybrids derived from it are the only fragrant hostas. As a wild plant, it is typically found growing in the [[Stratification (vegetation)#Herb layer|herb layer]] of mountain forests, below 2000{{nbsp}}m.<ref name="1_of_1180_Google_Scholar_Hits" >{{cite journal |title=''Hosta plantaginea'' (Lam.) Aschers (Yuzan): An overview on its botany, traditional use, phytochemistry, quality control and pharmacology |year=2019 |last1=Yang |first1=Li |last2=He |first2=Jun-Wei |journal=RSC Advances |volume=9 |issue=60 |pages=35050–35058 |doi=10.1039/C9RA06623C |bibcode=2019RSCAd...935050Y |doi-access=free |pmid=35530713 |pmc=9074421 }}</ref>
